limitations: The half coefficient is a liminf lower bound, not an exact layer asymptotic or optimizer classification.
The finite family certificate chooses among listed a/h values, not all parameters or configurations.
The crossing-interface example is already subject to other geometric exclusions; it demonstrates interface generality.
No complete eight-point sharp proof, exact gamma, crystallization or global priority claim.
AI independent checks are not external peer review or whole-proof formal verification.
